::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/analytics/query"}
#docs
Each entry answers exactly as `GET /v1/analytics` would, in the same order, tagged with the `key` you gave it.

**A refused question fails alone.** It comes back in its own slot as `object: analytics_error` with `status: 422` and the same explanatory sentence, and every other question still answers — one bad tile must not blank a board. The HTTP status is 200 whenever the batch itself was well formed.

Top-level `grain`, `range`, `start`, `end`, `currency`, `compare` and `business` are defaults; anything set on an individual query wins. Reads, so no `Idempotency-Key`.

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `queries` | `array of object` | **yes** | The questions, answered in this order. At most 24 — a board, not a crawl. |
| `queries.key` | `string` | no | Your label for this question, echoed on its answer. Defaults to its index (`q0`, `q1`, …). |
| `queries.measure` | `string` | **yes** | The measure id, as listed by `GET /v1/analytics/measures`. |
| `queries.grain` | `string` | no | Overrides the batch's `grain` for this question. One of `day`, `week`, `month`, `quarter`, `year`. |
| `queries.range` | `string` | no | A named window, overriding the batch's `range`. |
| `queries.start` | `string` | no | Explicit window start, overriding the batch's. |
| `queries.end` | `string` | no | Explicit window end, overriding the batch's. |
| `queries.split` | `string` | no | A dimension to cut this question by. |
| `queries.split_limit` | `integer` | no | How many split rows to keep before folding the rest into one `kind: truncated` row. Defaults to 20. |
| `queries.currency` | `string` | no | ISO 4217 code to state this question's figures in. |
| `queries.compare` | `string` | no | Add the previous equal-length window. One of `previous`. |
| `queries.shape` | `string` | no | `totals` leaves the periods out of this answer; see `shape` on GET /v1/analytics. One of `series`, `totals`. |
| `queries.segment` | `string` | no | A segment's id; see `segment` on GET /v1/analytics. |
| `queries.business` | `string` | no | Answer this question for one business (`biz_…`). |
| `grain` | `string` | no | Default grain for every question that does not set its own. One of `day`, `week`, `month`, `quarter`, `year`. |
| `range` | `string` | no | Default named window for every question that does not set its own. |
| `start` | `string` | no | Default explicit window start. |
| `end` | `string` | no | Default explicit window end. |
| `currency` | `string` | no | Default currency for every question that does not set its own. |
| `compare` | `string` | no | Default comparison for every question. One of `previous`. |
| `business` | `string` | no | Default business filter (`biz_…`). Omit for organization-wide answers. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | Always `analytics_batch`. One of `analytics_batch`. |
| `as_of` | `string · ISO-8601` | One instant for the whole batch, so the tiles on a board agree about "now". |
| `data` | `array of object` | One entry per question, in order: an `analytics_result` with a `key`, or an `analytics_error` carrying `status: 422` and the refusal's sentence. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | One answer or one refusal per question, in order |
| `400` | Malformed batch (no questions, or more than 24) |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/analytics/query" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "queries": [
      {
        "measure": "mrr",
        "currency": "USD"
      }
    ],
    "currency": "USD"
  }'
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "analytics_batch",
  "as_of": "2026-03-14T09:30:00Z",
  "data": [
    {
      "object": "analytics_result",
      "measure": "mrr",
      "name": "MRR",
      "description": "Everything a growing team needs.",
      "kind": "stock",
      "unit": "money"
    }
  ]
}
```
```json [400 Bad Request]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "Malformed batch (no questions, or more than 24)"
  }
}
```
```json [409 Conflict]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "idempotency_error",
    "message": "Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload."
  }
}
```
